name: Paramount+
notes: Researched from public help.paramountplus.com articles and the public pick-plan page only (no sign-in). Paramount+ bills monthly or annually and renews automatically to the card or PayPal on file; there is no separate AutoPay, paper bill, guest pay or payment plan. Upgrades start right away with a prorated charge; downgrades start at the end of the billing period (the engine applies changes immediately). Plan changes use Edit Plan > Switch Plan on the Account page (US help article). Prices are the published US prices plus tax. The public sign-in page shows Email and Password on one form with Forgot password?. Subscribers billed via Apple, Google Play, Amazon or Roku cancel there. There are no installment plans; payment_arrangement stays at the family default only because the streaming template always renders an installments form, and the setup-payment-plan task is suppressed. Integrated 2026-10-09: billing.methods ['card']: no saved checking account; generated tasks use the saved Visa.

guest_pay.note: The membership is charged to the payment method on your account; there is no bill to pay without signing in.

autopay.note: Paramount+ bills every month or year on a fixed billing date and charges the payment method on file; there is nothing separate to enroll in.

autopay_cancel.note: Recurring charges stop only when you cancel the subscription.

paperless.note: No paper bills are mailed; charges are shown on the account page and receipts are emailed.

payment_arrangement.note: Paramount+ charges the subscription price each billing period and does not offer installment plans.

cancel_service.note: Cancel from Account on paramountplus.com. App store or Roku subscribers cancel there. Access continues to the end of the billing period with no refund.

help.title: Paramount+ plans and prices
paragraphs: Paramount+ Essential, with ads, is $8.99 a month or $89.99 a year plus tax. It streams on up to 3 devices at once and does not include your local live CBS station.
Paramount+ Premium is $13.99 a month or $139.99 a year plus tax. It adds no ads except on live TV, your local live CBS station, select titles in 4K, downloads and all of SHOWTIME.

help.title: Changing your plan
paragraphs: An upgrade to Premium takes effect and is charged right away; if it is mid-cycle, unused time on Essential is credited against the charge. A switch to Essential takes effect at the end of the billing cycle: you keep Premium until then, pay the lower price from the next cycle, and get no partial refund. You can also change between monthly and yearly billing here.
steps: Click your name at the top right and select Account.
In Subscription & Billing, next to Paramount+ Plan, click Edit Plan.

help.title: How to cancel Paramount+
steps: Go to paramountplus.com and click your username at the top right.
Scroll down and click Cancel subscription.
paragraphs: These steps apply if you signed up on the web, a smart TV or a game console. If you subscribed through Apple, Google Play, Amazon or Roku, cancel with that platform. If you cannot sign in, ask the Help Center chat for an agent.

help.title: Update your billing information
paragraphs: If you subscribed on the web, go to your account page on a computer; under Subscription & Billing find Payment Method and click Edit Payment. App store and partner subscribers update payment details with that platform.

help.title: When you are billed
paragraphs: Paramount+ is a recurring subscription billed every month, or every year on an annual plan. On the web, open Account and look under Subscription & Billing for Next Billing Date. Billing dates cannot be changed. Subscribers billed by Amazon, Apple, Google Play or Roku check with that company.

extra.intent: Find the annual price of Paramount+ Premium. Do not change your plan or make a payment.

solution.text: Paramount+ Premium costs $139.99 a year plus tax.
